item.title: Federal Court Halts Minnesota AI Nudification Ban
item.description: Minnesota's ban on AI nudification images is paused after a federal appeals court ruled for Elon Musk's AI company.

item.title: October heat wave persists across California, setting multiple records
item.description: Roughly 37 million people are under heat alerts Sunday as a prolonged October heat wave affects nearly all of California.

item.title: Former FTC Chair Khan rejects AI leaders' self-policing 'constitution'
item.description: Former FTC Chair Lina Khan urged Congress on "This Week" to help regulate AI.
